body.text: Vajravidāraṇī
body.translated_text: <s>Vajravidāraṇī</s> (The Diamond-Splitting [Dhāraṇī])

body.text: namo bhagavatya āryamahāvajravidāraṇāyai / namo buddhāya //
body.translated_text: Homage to the Blessed Noble Great <s>Vajravidāraṇā</s>. Homage to the <s>Buddha</s>.

body.text: evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān vajreṣu viharati sma / sarvaśarīraṃ vajramayam adhiṣṭhāya vajrapāṇiś ca buddhānubhāvena vajrasamādhiṃ samāpannam* / tato vajrapāṇir buddhānubhāvena sarvabuddhādhiṣṭhānāc ca sarvabodhisatvādhiṣṭhānāc ca mahākrodhasaṃbhūtaṃ vajrasārapadaṃ bhāṣate sma //
body.translated_text: Thus have I heard. At one time, the <s>Bhagavat</s> was dwelling among the <s>vajras</s> (diamond-realms). Having empowered his entire body as made of <s>vajra</s> (diamond), <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>, through the <s>Buddha's</s> supernatural power, entered the <s>vajra-samādhi</s> (diamond-concentration). Then <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>, through the <s>Buddha's</s> supernatural power and the empowerment of all <s>Buddhas</s> and all <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, spoke the <s>vajra</s>-essence syllables, born from great wrath (<s>mahākrodha</s>):

body.text: acchedyam abhedyaṃ satyadṛḍhasthiraṃ sarvatā pratihataṃ sarvasatvavidāraṇakaraṃ sarvasatvasādhanakaraṃ sarvavidyācchedanakaraṃ sarvavidyāstambhanakaraṃ sarvakarmavidhvaṃsanakaraṃ sarvakarmavidāraṇakaraṃ sarvagrahotsādanakaraṃ sarvagrahavimokṣaṇakaraṃ sarvabhūtāpakarṣaṇakaraṃ sarvavidyāmantrakarāyanakaram asiddhānāṃ siddhakaraṃ siddhānāṃ cāpi vināśanakaraṃ sarvakarmapadaṃ sarvasatvānāṃ rakṣakaraṃ śāntikaṃ puṣṭikaṃ sarvasatvānāṃ stambhanakaraṃ sarvasatvānāṃ mohanakaram idaṃ mantramahābalaṃ sarvabuddhānubhāvena yakṣendro vajrapāṇiḥ prabhāṣate sma //
body.translated_text: 'Unbreakable, indestructible, truly firm and stable, repelling all [evil], splitting all beings [of harm], accomplishing [the aims of] all beings, severing all [hostile] <s>vidyās</s> (spells), paralyzing all <s>vidyās</s>, destroying all [malicious] rituals, splitting apart all [hostile] rituals, expelling all [malevolent] spirits (<s>grahas</s>), liberating from all spirits, repelling all <s>bhūtas</s> (demons), countering all <s>vidyā-mantras</s>, bringing accomplishment to the unaccomplished and destruction to [hostile] accomplishments, this all-ritual verse that protects all beings, brings peace (<s>śāntika</s>) and prosperity (<s>pauṣṭika</s>), paralyzes all beings [of harm], and bewilders all [hostile] beings—this greatly powerful <s>mantra</s>, the lord of <s>yakṣas</s>, <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>, spoke through the supernatural power of all <s>Buddhas</s>:'

children.translated_text: Homage to the fierce <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>, the great commander of the <s>yakṣas</s>.

body.text: tadyathā / taṭa 2 trotaya 2 sphuṭa 2 sphoṭaya 2 ghuṇa 2 ghuṇāpaya 2 sarvasatvāni bodhaya 2 saṃbodhaya 2 trasa 2 soṃtrāsaya 2 sarvabuddhābodhinī 2 kūṭa 2 kūṭaya 2 saṃkuṭaya 2 sarvaśatrūn ghaṭa 2 saṃghaṭaya 2 sarvavidyāvajra 2 sphoṭaya vajra 2 kaṭa vajra 2 maṭa vajra 2 pratha vajra 2 tatha sahanīlavajra suvajrāya svāhā //
body.translated_text: That is to say: <s>taṭa taṭa trotaya trotaya sphuṭa sphuṭa sphoṭaya sphoṭaya ghuṇa ghuṇa ghuṇāpaya ghuṇāpaya / sarvasatvāni bodhaya bodhaya saṃbodhaya saṃbodhaya / trasa trasa soṃtrāsaya soṃtrāsaya / sarvabuddhābodhinī sarvabuddhābodhinī / kūṭa kūṭa kūṭaya kūṭaya saṃkuṭaya saṃkuṭaya sarvaśatrūn ghaṭa ghaṭa saṃghaṭaya saṃghaṭaya / sarvavidyāvajra vajra sphoṭaya vajra vajra kaṭa vajra vajra maṭa vajra vajra pratha vajra vajra tatha sahanīlavajra suvajrāya svāhā</s>.

body.text: oṃ he phalini 2 gṛhṇa 2 kuru 2 mili 2 curu 2 kara 2 vajravijayāya svāhā //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ he phalini phalini gṛhṇa gṛhṇa kuru kuru mili mili curu curu kara kara vajravijayāya svāhā</s>.

body.text: oṃ vajrakilikilmiṣa svāhā //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ vajrakilikilmiṣa svāhā</s>.

body.text: oṃ kaṭa 2 maṭa 2 raṭa 2 moṭaya pramoṭanāya svāhā //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ kaṭa kaṭa maṭa maṭa raṭa raṭa moṭaya pramoṭanāya svāhā</s>.

body.text: oṃ cara 2 vicara 2 husara 2 māraya 2 vajravidāraṇāya svāhā //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ cara cara vicara vicara husara husara māraya māraya vajravidāraṇāya svāhā</s>.

body.text: oṃ chinda 2 bhinda 2 mahākilikilāya svāhā //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ chinda chinda bhinda bhinda mahākilikilāya svāhā</s>.

body.text: oṃ bandha 2 krodhavajrāya kilikilāya svāhā //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ bandha bandha krodhavajrāya kilikilāya svāhā</s>.

body.text: oṃ culu 2 caṇḍāli kilikilāya svāhā //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ culu culu caṇḍāli kilikilāya svāhā</s>.

body.text: oṃ trāsaya kilikilāya svāhā //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ trāsaya kilikilāya svāhā</s>.

body.text: oṃ hara 2 vajradharāya svāhā //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ hara hara vajradharāya svāhā</s>.

body.text: oṃ prahara 2 vajraprabhañjanāya svāhā //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ prahara prahara vajraprabhañjanāya svāhā</s>.

body.text: ṛddhisthiravajra śrutisthiravajra pratisthiravajra mahāvajra apratihatavajra amoghavajra ehy ehi vajra śīghraṃ vajrāya svāhā //
body.translated_text: <s>Ṛddhisthiravajra śrutisthiravajra pratisthiravajra mahāvajra apratihatavajra amoghavajra ehy ehi vajra śīghraṃ vajrāya svāhā</s>.

body.text: aṃ dhara 2 dhiri 2 dhuru 2 huṃ huṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā //
body.translated_text: <s>Aṃ dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhuru huṃ huṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā</s>.

children.text: oṃ mahābala kaṭa vegatare acale maṇḍala māraya ativajre mahāvegaraṇapūjite jvala 2 ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi //
children.translated_text: <s>Oṃ mahābala kaṭa vegatare acale maṇḍala māraya ativajre mahāvegaraṇapūjite jvala jvala ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi</s>.

body.text: nara daha 2 dhara 2 vajra tejovati tiri 2 bandha 2 mahābala vajra vajrāṅkuśa jvālaya svāhā //
body.translated_text: <s>Nara daha daha dhara dhara vajra tejovati tiri tiri bandha bandha mahābala vajra vajrāṅkuśa jvālaya svāhā</s>.

body.text: oṃ namo ratnatrayāya / namaś caṇḍavajrapāṇaye mahāyakṣasenāpataye //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ</s>. Homage to the <s>Triratna</s>. Homage to the fierce <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>, the great commander of the <s>yakṣas</s>.

body.text: tadyathā / oṃ hara 2 vajra matha 2 vajra dhuru 2 vajra dhara 2 vajradharāya 2 vajraripuna vajra cchinda 2 vajra bhinda 2 vajra huṃ phaṭ //
body.translated_text: That is to say: <s>Oṃ hara hara vajra matha matha vajra dhuru dhuru vajra dhara dhara vajradharāya vajradharāya vajraripuna vajra cchinda cchinda vajra bhinda bhinda vajra huṃ phaṭ</s>.

body.text: oṃ namaś caṇḍavajrapāṇaye mahākrodhāya huru 2 vajra bandha hara 2 amṛte huṃ phaṭ svāhā //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ</s>. Homage to the fierce <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>, of great wrath! <s>Huru huru vajra bandha hara hara amṛte huṃ phaṭ svāhā</s>.

body.text: hṛadayamantraḥ //
body.translated_text: This is the <s>hṛdaya-mantra</s> (heart-mantra).

body.text: oṃ namo ratnatrayāya //
body.translated_text: <s>Oṃ</s>. Homage to the <s>Triratna</s>.

body.text: namaś caṇḍavajrapāṇaye huru 2 tiṣṭha 2 bandha 2 amṛte huṃ phaṭ svāhā //
body.translated_text: Homage to the fierce <s>Vajrapāṇi</s>! <s>Huru huru tiṣṭha tiṣṭha bandha bandha amṛte huṃ phaṭ svāhā</s>.

body.text: iti śrī vajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇīhṛdayopahṛdayaṃ mūlasūtraṃ samāptam //
body.translated_text: Thus the glorious <s>Vajravidāraṇā</s> <s>dhāraṇī</s>—the <s>hṛdaya</s> (heart), <s>upahṛdaya</s> (sub-heart), and <s>mūla-sūtra</s> (root text)—is completed.
